summary: JADE OS P3 backend testing complete — MOAT (Schema Library, Prompt Library, Playbooks, Model Router, schema corrections, moat stats/admin) + LIGHTHOUSE Customer Program (apply, list, patch, stats, agent-run logging). Added 30 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/backend_test_p3.py — ALL 30 PASSED. Regression of prior 56 tests (iter1 + iter2): 55 passed first run, 1 flaky failure (test_extract_pdf_happy) due to upstream OpenAI provider 'Budget exceeded' 500 — passed on retry. No code bugs introduced. Total backend coverage: 86 tests across 3 files.

minor.issue: Transient 500 from underlying OpenAI provider due to 'Budget has been exceeded' (litellm.BadRequestError). Not a JADE bug — upstream LLM quota. Test passes on retry. Recommend graceful fallback to alternate provider when one provider's budget is exhausted (currently surfaces raw 500).

Synchronous LLM call (10–20s) inside POST. For form submission UX, consider scoring asynchronously and returning immediately with score=null + tier='pending', or stream the score back. Public endpoint can be DoS'd by triggering many LLM calls (no rate limit).
Public (no auth) and chains 2–3 LLM calls per request — same DoS surface as above. Consider auth or basic IP rate-limit.
Public (no auth) — anyone can drive LLM spend. Recommend admin-only or rate-limit by IP/session.
No pagination — returns up to 200. Fine now, will need pagination at scale.

action_items: Add IP/session rate-limit (or auth) to public LLM-driving endpoints: /api/lighthouse/apply, /api/playbooks/run, /api/prompts/run. They can be abused to drain LLM budget.
Wrap LLM provider errors (e.g. 'Budget exceeded') and fall back to alternate provider in MODEL_ROUTING instead of raising 500. Currently a hard provider failure breaks the endpoint.
Consider async/background scoring for /api/lighthouse/apply so form submission returns instantly.
server.py is now 1729 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers: moat.py (schemas+prompts+playbooks), lighthouse.py, billing.py, kb.py, webhooks.py, agents.py.
Add pagination (?limit&offset or cursor) to /api/lighthouse/applications and /api/playbook-runs before scaling.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py = 1729 lines — over 2x the 700-line guideline. Must be modularized into routers for maintainability.
PROMPT_SEED & PLAYBOOK_SEED & SCHEMA_SEED use $setOnInsert-style seeding (presumed at startup) — content edits to seeds won't reflect on existing DB rows. Document this or version-bump on change.
/api/lighthouse/apply runs an LLM call inline on a PUBLIC endpoint with no rate limit — DoS / cost-abuse vector.
/api/playbooks/run is public and chains multiple LLM calls — same DoS vector and bigger cost amplifier (2-3x per request).

/api/prompts/run is public and lets a caller execute ANY stored prompt with arbitrary variables. Combined with arbitrary {{var}} interpolation, this is effectively user-controlled LLM access. Lock down or rate-limit.
_score_lighthouse catches all LLM/parse exceptions and returns score=None silently — admin won't know the auto-scorer is broken. Log + surface a 'scorer_failed' flag.

Playbook step error handling logs exceptions but step.status defaults to 'ok' unless explicitly set — verify failed steps mark status='error' (couldn't fully audit in this iteration since happy-path passed).
Schema correction endpoint accepts arbitrary org_email without verifying caller owns that tenant — multi-tenant trust issue.

success_rate.backend: 100% (86/86: 30 P3 new + 26 P2 + 30 P1, after 1 flaky retry on LLM budget error)

All TEST_ prefixed — main agent can purge with db.lighthouse_applications.delete_many({'email': /TEST_/}) etc.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three pytest files in /app/backend/tests: backend_test.py (P1, 30 tests), backend_test_p2.py (P2, 26 tests), backend_test_p3.py (P3, 30 tests). All XMLs in /app/test_reports/pytest/. Cumulative 86 tests; ~30s for P3 alone, ~90s for full regression. NOTE: test_extract_pdf_happy is flaky — depends on OpenAI provider having budget. Retry if it fails with 'Budget exceeded'. Backend server.py is 1729 lines and needs router-splitting.
rca of the issue: No new bugs introduced this round. The single flaky regression failure (test_extract_pdf_happy) RCA: OpenAI provider hit a 'Max budget' soft cap returning 500 via litellm. JADE doesn't catch/retry across providers, so the 500 propagates. Mitigation: catch provider budget errors and silently fall back to the alternate provider in MODEL_ROUTING (or to Anthropic for OpenAI failures and vice versa). Reproduction: not deterministic — depends on provider budget state at the time of test. Mitigation in test: retry once on 500 from provider budget error.
